entries.back_en: "Hmmm... If only Tarhn were here! She'd know what to do!"
"Huh!? B-but Master... You... You mean... I'm weak?"
"Off to Wyndia to meet with the dragon, hm? Well, I guess that kills two birds with one stone, doesn't it? You might find out something about"
"Huh? What am I doing here, you ask? Well, let us just say that it is harder to"
entries.note: Sentido mantido; sotaque omitido mas aceitavel.

entries.back_en: "Did you hear how Chief went out in search of the missing Wyndian princess? How romantic!"
"Only thing we know how to do is fight... Not Tarhn, though! She'd think of something, for sure!"
"Thank you for everything. We'll help you as much as we can, but I think you should talk to Tarhn about what to do."
